name: browser
description: Persistent private browser automation for linked Elowen accounts. Each account gets its own Chrome profile and process with multiple tab sessions, accessibility-first typed actions, bounded live screencast streaming, exclusive user takeover, authenticated account-owned API routes, and a deny-by-default enforcing network proxy boundary.

configSchema.label: Runtime
configSchema.hint: Chrome detection and account-level process limits. Browser launch is refused unless the enforcing proxy and Chrome sandbox path are available.

configSchema.label: Chrome executable
configSchema.hint: Optional absolute path to Chrome or Chromium. Leave empty to use a supported system executable.

configSchema.label: Active accounts
configSchema.hint: Maximum number of account-owned Chrome processes running at once.

configSchema.label: Tab sessions per account
configSchema.hint: Maximum number of browser tab sessions one account may keep open in its Chrome process.

configSchema.label: Idle timeout
configSchema.hint: Close a browser session after this long without agent, user or viewer activity.

configSchema.label: Hard session limit
configSchema.hint: Absolute lifetime of one browser session, including time under user control.

configSchema.label: Process close grace
configSchema.hint: How long an account's Chrome process remains available after its last tab closes. The profile stays on disk.

configSchema.label: Takeover lease
configSchema.hint: User control must heartbeat within this lease. A stale modal cannot extend or release a newer lease.

configSchema.label: Chrome targets per account
configSchema.hint: Includes pages, popups, workers and other Chrome targets. New targets over the limit are closed.

configSchema.label: Network policy
configSchema.hint: All Chrome traffic must pass through a loopback proxy that resolves, approves and pins the destination address before dialing.

configSchema.label: Private network allowlist
configSchema.hint: Exact hostnames or CIDRs explicitly allowed for local development. Empty blocks private, loopback, link-local and metadata networks.

strings.accountDescription: Your private Chrome profile keeps browser sign-ins between sessions on this Elowen instance.
strings.settingsDescription: Live capacity and isolation status for managed Chrome sessions.
strings.closeConfirmDescription: The live view and tab will close. Your browser profile and sign-in data remain stored.
strings.liveCapacityHint: Only counts active Chrome processes and tab sessions. Browser content remains private to its account.
strings.isolationHint: Every account has a separate persistent profile and Chrome process. All traffic must cross the pinned enforcing proxy.
strings.limitsHint: The sliders above are enforced before allocating Chrome, frames, viewers or input events.
strings.limitsBody: Idle and hard timeouts close sessions automatically. Stream frames use a bounded latest-frame queue and a global bitrate budget.
strings.depsHint: Everything a managed browser session needs before it can start. These checks only read: the sandbox and the DevTools connection are verified by the first managed launch.
strings.dep_chrome_missing: No supported Chrome or Chromium executable was found on this host.
strings.dep_chrome_missing_fix: Install Google Chrome or Chromium, or set the executable in this plugin’s settings.
strings.dep_chrome_unusable: The configured executable is missing or cannot be executed by the daemon account.
strings.dep_chrome_unusable_fix: Correct the Chrome executable in this plugin’s settings, or clear it to detect one automatically.
strings.dep_control_missing: puppeteer-core is missing from the daemon runtime, or does not expose launch().
strings.dep_control_missing_fix: The plugin shares the Elowen daemon’s runtime dependencies: reinstall or update Elowen with its runtime dependencies, then restart the daemon.
strings.dep_proxy_missing: proxy-chain 3.0 cannot be loaded, so browser launch is refused.
strings.dep_proxy_missing_fix: The plugin shares the Elowen daemon’s runtime dependencies: reinstall or update Elowen with its runtime dependencies, then restart the daemon.
strings.dep_proxy_unsupported: The proxy adapter cannot pin DNS per request, so browser launch is refused.
strings.dep_proxy_unsupported_fix: Restore the bundled proxy adapter; a browser session may only reach a host the navigation policy resolved.
strings.dep_storage_unwritable: The profile directory cannot be written by the daemon account.
strings.dep_storage_unwritable_fix: Give the daemon account write access to the plugin data directory, then restart the daemon.
strings.dep_storage_exposed: The profile directory is readable beyond the daemon account.
strings.dep_storage_exposed_fix: Restrict the plugin data directory to owner-only access, then restart the daemon.
strings.dep_storage_missing: The profile directory is no longer the trusted directory the plugin created.
strings.dep_storage_missing_fix: Restore the plugin data directory as a real directory owned by the daemon account, then restart the daemon.
strings.dep_artifacts_missing: This host has no inline chat artifact bridge, so sessions run without a live card in chat.
strings.dep_artifacts_missing_fix: Update Elowen to a release that publishes inline chat artifacts.
strings.profileStorageHint: Cookies and sign-in state live only in your account profile. Live images are never stored.
strings.liveSessionsHint: Closing a tab session does not erase your saved browser profile.
strings.noSessionsDescription: A session appears here when your agent opens the browser.
strings.clearConfirmDescription: Stored cookies, sign-ins and site data will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
